templates.name: Transformation
templates.description: From today's architecture to a target, through one or more intermediate states, with gaps and a migration roadmap.

slots.label: Current state
slots.help: The model of how things are today.

slots.label: Target state
slots.help: The model of how things should be: usually derived from the current state and kept linked so it can merge back.

slots.label: Transition states
slots.help: Intermediate states between current and target (TOGAF transition architectures), numbered in order. Optional.

slots.label: Reference models
slots.help: Models read for context only (read only for everyone on the project).

templates.finish: Merge the target state into the current state when it is reached (Finish › merge into its parent).

templates.name: Scenario planning
templates.description: Explore two or more possible target states from the same current state and compare them (what-if).

slots.label: Current state
slots.help: The model of how things are today.

slots.label: Scenarios
slots.help: Each an alternative target, copied from the current state; compare them on the gap screen.

slots.label: Reference models
slots.help: Models read for context only (read only for everyone on the project).

templates.finish: Keep the chosen scenario (merge it into its parent, or carry it into a Transformation project); freeze the others.
